up: Show the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613992. Return the molecule CHEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the standard type (e.g., IC50), the standard value, and the standard units. Only include rows where the standard relation is '=' (exact values) and the standard value is not null.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613992') AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
